say:1:1730204401:1.text: Ah, you're here... Orion's escaped, and I'm trying to track him down.
say:1:1730204401:1.source_cn: 原来是您……我正沿着奥利安逃跑的路线搜寻他们的踪迹。
say:1:1730204401:1.male: Ah, you're here... Orion's escaped, and I'm trying to track him down.
say:1:1730204401:1.female: Ah, you're here... Orion's escaped, and I'm trying to track him down.

say:2:1730204402:1.text: The Queen wants us to find both Orion and the Mauler who took him away.
say:2:1730204402:1.source_cn: 王后下了命令，让我们一定要找到奥利安以及带他离开的那个蛮血。
say:2:1730204402:1.male: The Queen wants us to find both Orion and the Mauler who took him away.
say:2:1730204402:1.female: The Queen wants us to find both Orion and the Mauler who took him away.

say:4:1730204403:1.text: As you can see, my comrades and I have been searching along their escape route...
say:4:1730204403:1.source_cn: 如您所见，我和不少守备军一起在沿着逃跑路线搜索踪迹……
say:4:1730204403:1.male: As you can see, my comrades and I have been searching along their escape route...
say:4:1730204403:1.female: As you can see, my comrades and I have been searching along their escape route...

say:5:1730204404:1.text: But so far, we haven't been able to find any solid leads.
say:5:1730204404:1.source_cn: 不过到目前为止，我们还没有找到他们逃跑的明确踪迹。
say:5:1730204404:1.male: But so far, we haven't been able to find any solid leads.
